---
title: "Controlled vocabularies"
subtitle: "Allowed tokens for source and timeline records"
---

Use these values unless a pull request updates this page first. Do not invent near-synonyms (`official`, `public-pdf`, `rumoured`) in front matter.

## `source_type`

| Token | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `primary` | Contemporaneous document, record, or other first-hand artefact from the period under study |
| `near-primary` | Close to the events or created from them (for example a commissioned review that quotes files the archive does not have) |
| `secondary` | Later narrative, journalism, or scholarship that is not itself the event record |
| `oral-history` | Recorded or transcribed recollection, published only with permission |
| `reference-finding-aid` | Catalogue record, bibliography, archival description, or this site’s own template/finding aid |

Display form `reference / finding-aid` maps to `reference-finding-aid`.

## `availability`

| Token | Meaning |
| --- | --- |
| `full-text-public` | A copy this project may point to (or host) as publicly readable |
| `external-link-only` | Full text exists at a stable external URL; we do not host the file |
| `catalogue-or-citation-only` | We have a citation or catalogue entry, not the text |
| `known-to-exist-copy-sought` | The item is attested; this archive does not have a copy |
| `physical-copy-known` | A physical location is known; no digital copy is held here |
| `permission-required` | A copy exists but may not be published or quoted beyond fair identification without permission |

## `verification_status`

See [Evidence and verification statuses](evidence-status.qmd) for definitions. Tokens:

- `verified-inspected`
- `bibliographically-confirmed`
- `attributed-recollection`
- `interpretation`
- `conflicting-evidence`
- `open-question`
